scientific_integrity: The stated probability space fixes each hyperplane at the center and averages only Haar orientation; it is not the uniform-translated random-flat model. No external certification or independently validated novelty is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Central codimension-one sections of strictly positive orthotopes in dimensions at least four; first vertex-count moment only. Sharp lower bound is not attained by nondegenerate boxes, all-dimensional claims are analytic rather than computer-certified, and historical priority is not independently audited.
title: Strict Schur monotonicity of random central orthotope-section vertex counts
